title: Autumn mock feedback and intervention
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

questions.prompt: A rising-edge D flip-flop samples D=1 at the first clock edge. D then changes to 0 between edges, and another rising edge occurs. State Q immediately after the first edge, between edges, and after the second edge.
questions.answer: Q=1 immediately after first rising edge; remains 1 between edges even though D changes; at next rising edge Q becomes 0.
options: Q=0 immediately after first rising edge; remains 1 between edges even though D changes; at next rising edge Q becomes 0.
Q=1 immediately after first rising edge; remains 1 between edges even though D changes; at next rising edge Q becomes 0.
Q=2 immediately after first rising edge; remains 1 between edges even though D changes; at next rising edge Q becomes 0.
questions.feedback: Model answer: Q=1 immediately after first rising edge; remains 1 between edges even though D changes; at next rising edge Q becomes 0.

blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: diagnostic — Assessment used to locate a learning gap.
method mark — Credit for a correct intermediate step.
transfer — Applying a method to a changed problem.
correction — Justified replacement for incorrect reasoning.

blocks.title: Diagnose the weakness
blocks.text: Look for a pattern across the marked questions: omitted intermediate states, incorrect notation or missed explanations.

blocks.title: Rebuild the method
blocks.text: Model each calculation, comparison or state change instead of simply copying the final answer.

blocks.title: Test transfer
blocks.text: Give students a different array or bit pattern and check whether they can produce the same method independently.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: Start with +9 in exactly eight bits and invert it.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain the answer
blocks.text: Add one to give 11110111, representing −9. This explicitly shows the stages.
